summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US analogue of a US 8-K) on October 9, 2026, enclosing a press release announcing the completed bookbuilding of a domestic TRY 500 million financing bond. The 91-day bill matures January 8, 2027, carries a 37.00% annual simple fixed rate (42.4638% compounded), and was privately placed to qualified investors in Turkiye at par under a TRY 15 billion Capital Markets Board issuance limit. JCR Avrasya rated it investment grade (J1+ short-term, AAA long-term national). No equity, ownership or deal terms are implicated; routine debt financing warrants no special-situations angle.
